scope.static: same 300 fetch/60 codec/15 archive/20 unit rows
scope.playgrounds: same 683 runs at local network; same default compatibility exclusions

limitations: Single host, headless Chromium; playground network=local only.
Static fetch: 2 warmups + 10 samples. Codec decode: 2 warmups + 10 samples. Encode/archive: single samples. Units: 3 warmups + 30 samples.
JSON and diff matrix use 3 iterations; browser fetch/apply diff/scenarios generally 5; app benchmark 3; partial-fetch 5 independent single runs per target/mode.
Not every UI stores raw samples: JSON, diff matrix and app store aggregates.
NDJSON wireBytes is response Content-Length even when scanning stops early; not measured consumed wire bytes.
SSR playground times decode after page load, not server rendering or first paint.
Small differences and sub-millisecond results are noisy. Fixed variant order is not randomized.
The high-entropy generated script has an ID mismatch; all six delivery variants fail and are excluded from timing rankings.
measurementNotes: Main matrix ran after shared/browser optimizations. Node-specific router cache change was added afterward and tested with the isolated router reuse probe; the matrix contains no Node router workloads.
Node router probe compares the old/new router implementations using the same current underlying decode pipeline, isolating file reuse.
App bootloaders were rebuilt to embed the optimized browser runtime; payload fixture manifests were unchanged.
Encoding algorithms and fixture content were unchanged. Server benchmark artifacts were regenerated and measurements refreshed.
All timings are observations on one host, not statistical significance claims.
